name: Camp Allen New Hampshire
description_short: Camp Allen in Bedford, NH runs day and residential (overnight) camp sessions for people with developmental and/or physical disabilities, and has done so since 1931. It also offers Life Camp, an independent-living program for young adults, and CamPower, a work skills training program for adults.
special_needs_notes: The camp serves only individuals with developmental and/or physical disabilities. The page gives no details on staffing ratios, medical support or the needs it can accommodate.
